findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_my_otovo" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: code, device_id, id, location_id, node_id, query, service_type, site_id, view, week_start

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: preview_change · Private data: get_my_otovo, find_inspection_times, preview_change · Public sink: preview_change.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: preview_change · Private data: get_my_otovo, find_inspection_times, preview_change · Public sink: preview_change

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
